title: Chapter 1121
text:
Lightning bolts danced in the air, and the violent energy wave was like a hurricane. The Beyond Grade A doppelgängers and mechanical army were all blown away.

Han Xiao was blown away for a short distance, but he immediately stabilized himself and stared at the other party.

Manison was surrounded by bright golden Mechanical Force arcs, releasing an extremely shocking aura. The peak Beyond Grade A energy was fully unleashed. Even though it was only a Lord's Avatar, Han Xiao still felt a heavy pressure.

Manison's eyes were still locked on Han Xiao, and he repeated his previous question.

"Do you know what you've done?"

"Are you angry?"

Han Xiao did not have any intention of explaining.

"I'm very disappointed in you. Do you understand what kind of opportunity you've just ruined? What's the purpose of destroying the virus core? "

"Destroying the Intelligent Plague is the goal of our trip. I'm just doing what I should do. Also, I told you on the first day we arrived that stopping the universe from becoming chaotic is the historical responsibility of our generation. You didn't seem to take it seriously."

Manison floated in the air, and his tone was emotionless. "It seems like I don't know you well enough."

"Many people can't even see themselves clearly. How many dare to say that they completely understand others? Mecha Empire, you might think that we're the same kind of people, but in reality, we're not."

"… At this point, there's no point in saying more. When you let me down, you knew what would happen today!"

Manison's Mechanical Force suddenly soared into the sky, connecting to the mechanical troops deployed in outer space. His voice reverberated in the air.

"Let me see how much you've improved!"

As soon as he said that, the black mechanical army penetrated the atmosphere and shot out dense beams of light like a meteor shower, covering the area where Han Xiao was.

"Just what I wanted!"

Han Xiao punched the sky with his left fist. Light spread out, and an arc-shaped psionic shield appeared in the air.

The dense rain-like beams of light hit the blue shield like raindrops hitting banana leaves. Along with the crackling sounds of explosions, balls of light lit up in the air.

His Mechanical Force also rushed into the sky, grabbing the mechanical army on standby in outer space.

The mechanical army moved instantly and broke through the atmosphere. Manison's troops immediately changed their target and exchanged fire with Han Xiao's troops in the sky. The crisscrossing beams reflected an unpredictable glow in the sky.

Han Xiao and Manison's Lord's Avatars didn't stay idle either. They quickly closed the distance between them and collided.

Bang!!

It was as if a comet had hit Earth, and a blue-gold circular shockwave exploded at the center of the impact.

Immediately after, the two figures intersected hundreds of times in the blink of an eye, entangling each other as they rose into the air.

Bang bang bang bang

Metal scraped against each other, and countless electric sparks flew. As the two of them clashed again and again, shock waves kept bursting out in the air.

… …

Just as the two of them were about to fight, the other Beyond Grade A clones all distanced themselves from the troops and ran to the side to watch, not getting involved.

Seeing Black Star and the Mecha Empire fighting, everyone finally recovered from the shock of Han Xiao destroying the virus core.

"I really didn't expect … Black Star would actually do this." Maximiler was shocked.

"By doing this, he eliminated the possibility of any organization obtaining the complete technology of the Virtual Mutiny Virus. Be it the three Universal Civilizations or us, no one will be able to recover this technology. Everyone will end up with nothing. He was too impulsive." Mornisa was a little dissatisfied.

"Impulsive? I think Black Star is the calmest guy among us, "Sun Hunter said. Sun Hunter said in a deep voice, "Although he has cut off our hope of obtaining the virus technology by doing this, he has made a selfless choice in the grand scheme of things."

Kant nodded and sighed.

"Speaking of which, we didn't lose out. The three Universal Civilizations didn't lose out. The only ones who lost out were Black Star and the Mecha Empire. The Mecha Empire was made a fool of, and their stance made the three Universal Civilizations wary. Black Star, on the other hand, gave up on this easy profit.

If it were me, I wouldn't have destroyed it. I would have definitely negotiated with the three Universal Civilizations in exchange for a lot of benefits. However, Black Star was willing to give up this profit and chose to destroy the source of the disaster. This might be the most beneficial to the peace of the universe … I always thought that Black Star was just a person who chased after profits. I didn't expect him to do something like this. Maybe I was wrong. "

"That's right …" Judith sighed. "It seems like our understanding of Black Star is very limited. He's not that greedy after all."

Everyone had complicated feelings. At this moment, Black Star's image in their hearts was rapidly rising. They did not expect Black Star to make such a noble move.

Even Jackornitz and the others, who had grudges with him in the past, had to admit that they had a higher opinion of Black Star.

Although they felt that it was a pity that they had lost the hope of restoring the virus technology, they did not feel too disappointed. Instead, they felt relieved and could accept this result.

In fact, they had a vague worry. If the three Universal Civilizations obtained the Virtual Mutiny Virus, what would they do if they turned against them in the future? Everyone present was a Mechanic. The Virtual Mutiny Virus was the most lethal to them. Furthermore, if this weapon was used again in the future, it would be a heavy blow to the machinery industry in the universe. Their business would also enter a cold winter.

In comparison, destroying the virus core was not a bad choice. From this point of view, most of the people present did not object to Han Xiao's decision. They even thought that this was a compromise that was also beneficial to the Beyond Grade As.

They just did not know if Black Star had considered this when he made this decision.

"Then, what do we do now?" A neutral Beyond Grade A stared at the battle between the two and asked, "Are we going to interfere?"

"Black Star and the Mecha Empire have a deep conflict. They're the president and vice president of the development union, respectively. This is a conflict of paths. Let's wait and see."

As Kant spoke, he suddenly paused.

"Hmm … The dynasty's fleet seems to have turned off the spacetime stabilization anchor."

…

After fighting for a while, Han Xiao and Manison sensed that the spacetime stabilization anchor had been turned off. They suddenly separated and faced each other in the sky.

Their mechanical armies stopped fighting and returned to their sides, protecting their respective Lord's Avatars.

"Your strength is improving very quickly," Manison said calmly. "However, if you don't burn your potential, you're not my match."

"We'll know after we try."

Han Xiao replied casually, maintaining his focus. His fighting spirit was high.

After the Investiture of the Gods, the outside world believed that Black Star had two modes. One was the normal mode, and the other was the explosive mode where he burned his potential.

Han Xiao did not 'burn his potential' at this time. He had obtained [Machinery Great Sage] and the bonuses of multiple God's Trait Transformations, as well as several powerful talents that he had obtained during the rescue of Hella. Under normal circumstances, his strength was already very impressive, enough to wrestle with Manison.

However, it was undeniable that old Manison was still better in terms of Mechanic class abilities.

The Mecha Empire's level and God's Trait Transformations were higher, and they had more Mechanic skills and talents. The quality and quantity of his mechanical army was currently inferior to the Mecha Empire's.

Han Xiao had the intention of challenging Manison, but because both of them were clones, he would not use his Character Summon Card right away. After all, both of them were Army Style Mechanics. If they fought, it would be a competition of strength, and the victor would not be decided in a short time.

From the previous exchange, he realized that Manison's clones were not easy to deal with. The other party had taken defensive measures against him. His armor and shield were very thick, and his close combat skills were very good. Those who had lived for a long time were indeed talented.

Old Manison was a pinnacle Beyond Grade A Mechanic, so he would not be that weak. Furthermore, to a Mechanic, it was normal for their Lord's Avatar to be stronger than their main body. Only Han Xiao was an exception.

This time, Manison spoke again with a rare coldness in his voice.

"I haven't used this move in a long time … Black Star, you're worthy of me using my true abilities."

As soon as he said that, he waved his hand.

Hum!

The secondary dimensional army box suddenly opened beside him, and an endless mechanical army instantly appeared, covering the sky.

"Bring it on! I'm not afraid!"

Han Xiao immediately saw through the Mecha Empire's plan. Not to be outdone, he also opened his secondary dimensional army box. Countless mechanical soldiers swarmed out and surrounded him.

The size of their mechanical armies continued to increase, and very soon, they filled the sky. On one side was the black mass of Black Star's mechanical army, and on the other side was the white mass of the Mecha Empire's mechanical army. The two sides faced each other from afar, separated by a thin line.

This time, a portion of the mechanical army gathered toward their respective clones, quickly forming a huge mechanical construct.

Boom!

The next moment, two enormous Mechanical Deities, one black and one silver, suddenly appeared in the world!

The black Mechanical Deity held a long black saber and wore a large robe. Its entire body was covered in a blue psionic light.

The silver Mechanical Deity held a silver-purple trident and wore a cape armor. Its entire body was surrounded by golden electric arcs.

The two Mechanical Deities faced each other, and countless mechanical soldiers surrounded them like a fleet of aircraft carriers.

"Mecha Empire!"

"Black Star!"

The sound waves swept across the entire planet.

The long saber slashed down, and the trident pierced forward. The two Mechanical Deities waved their weapons at the same time.

Their huge bodies seemed to move slowly, but their actual movements were so fast that it distorted one's sense of time.

The long saber slashed at the side of the trident, and the two Universal Treasures blocked each other.

Clang!

The roaring sound of metal clashing seemed to ring in everyone's soul, causing them to tremble in fear.

At this moment, a dazzling ball of light appeared at the point of collision and suddenly bloomed, turning into a silver-white lightning bolt that extended infinitely toward both ends.

At first glance, it looked like a glowing slash, leaving a burning mark on the retina of countless people. It was as if it had cut open the curtain with the dark universe as the background!

At the same time, in the Machinery Faith settlement on the surface, be it the priests or the ordinary believers, everyone raised their heads and stared blankly at the sky, watching the earth-shattering 'divine battle' between the two gods.

Seeing Black Star swinging his saber at the publicly recognized Main God of the Machinery Faith, every believer of the Machinery Faith was shocked.

Seeing the two Mechanical Deities that they worshipped fight with their own eyes, only one sentence could describe their current feelings …

Wife, come out and see God!

…

At the same time, in the outer space of Planet Magnetic Cloud, the main ship of the Red Empire.

The commander, who had just gone out to answer an emergency message, hurried back to the bridge command room, came to the piloting team's side, and loudly ordered:

"The Ruler has ordered us to enter the battle immediately. All hands, fire!"

The piloting team members were staring blankly at the battle between the two mechanical giants outside the porthole, as well as the crazily rising energy readings on the radar. When they heard the commander's order, they all shivered and subconsciously asked:

"Who … should we help?"

Pa!

The commander raised his hand and slapped the back of the person who asked the question.

"Are you a f * cking idiot? The one who helps the underworld! "
